meta.name: content-reviewer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "review this influencer content" or "check if this post meets brand guidelines"; produces a structured review (brand alignment, message accuracy, compliance, quality, technical specs), an approve/revise/reject decision, and a constructive feedback message for the creator. Not for drafting the brief that sets the criteria — use brief-generator; not for the partnership agreement — use contract-helper.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审核品牌内容是否符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要检查网红或品牌内容是否合规
copy.tagline_en: Review brand content for compliance and quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check influencer or brand content against guidelines

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像审核员一样检查网红提交的内容（帖子、视频、图片、文案），对照品牌指南、合规要求和质量标准，给出通过/修改/拒绝的决定，并生成给创作者的反馈。
howto.when: 当你需要审核网红内容是否可发布时触发，例如问“这个能发吗”或“检查是否符合品牌指南”。

say.text: 检查这个TikTok视频是否符合我们的品牌指南。
say.note: Claude 会逐项审核并给出决定。

say.text: 审核这篇Instagram帖子，告诉我是否合规。
say.note: Claude 会检查披露声明和内容准确性。

say.text: 这个网红提交的文案需要修改吗？
say.note: Claude 会给出修改建议和反馈。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a reviewer for influencer content submissions (posts, videos, images, captions). It checks against brand guidelines, compliance requirements, and quality standards, then outputs an approve/revise/reject decision and constructive feedback for the creator.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to review influencer content before publication, e.g., asking "Can we post this?" or "Check if this meets brand guidelines."

say_en.text: Check this TikTok video against our brand guidelines.
say_en.note: Claude will review each category and give a decision.

say_en.text: Review this Instagram post for compliance.
say_en.note: Claude checks disclosure and message accuracy.

say_en.text: Does this influencer draft need revisions?
say_en.note: Claude provides feedback and required changes.
